newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds close at highs.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds close at highs.

text.p: Portuguese bonds surged to close at record highs as the market adjusted to the firm trend in Europe and a strengthening dollar, dealers said.
"December futures closed buoyant and near resistance at 106.50 and cash was at record highs following the trend in Europe," said one operator.
Dealers said they expected the market to follow Bonos on Tuesday. The market will be closed for a holiday on Monday.
